title: 第一卷 第4章 你俩说话都挺危险
slug: 全网黑上恋综后我爆红了
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

主持人继续公布：“陆执，收到零条。”

全场：“？”

弹幕：“？”

宋尔尔也愣了一下。

陆执零条？

这么勇？

下一秒，她手机亮起。

节目组把收到的短信发到了她的手机上。

宋尔尔低头看。

屏幕上只有一句话。

【你说得对。】

没有署名。

但她几乎立刻猜到了是谁。

宋尔尔抬头，看向对面的陆执。

陆执也正好看她。

他神色淡定，像什么都没发生。

宋尔尔盯了他两秒。

然后她转头问主持人：“现在退回还来得及吗？”

主持人：“？”

宋尔尔一本正经：“我怕陆老师粉丝今晚暗杀我。”

陆执放下手机，语气平稳：“不用怕。”

宋尔尔：“怎么，你保护我？”

陆执看她一眼：“她们骂不过你。”

宋尔尔：“……”

客厅里终于有人没忍住笑出声。

弹幕彻底炸了。

【哈哈哈哈哈哈陆执你变了！】

【她们骂不过你，这是什么信任？】

【我本来是陆执粉，现在想听宋尔尔骂人。】

【这节目不叫心动不设防了，改叫宋尔尔不设防吧。】

【完了，我好像有点想追了。】

导演棚里，刘导看着还在上涨的数据，陷入长久沉默。

副导演问：“导演，明天还按原剧本走吗？”

刘导看着监视器里正在和陆执互怼的宋尔尔，缓缓摇头。

“原剧本？”

他笑了一声。

“从她进门那一刻起，原剧本就死了。”

与此同时，宋尔尔的手机又震了一下。

这次不是节目组手机。

是她自己的手机。

钱姐发来一条新消息。

【宋尔尔，你今晚最好收敛一点。】

宋尔尔看完，低头回复。

【尽量。】

想了想，她又补了一句。

【但不保证。】

发完，她把手机塞回兜里，抬头看向镜头。

镜头正好对着她。

宋尔尔笑了一下。

Page (1/3)

The host continued to announce: "Lu Zhi, received zero messages."

Everyone: "?"

Barrage: "?"

Song Er'er was also stunned for a moment.

Lu Zhi Ling Tiao?

So brave?

The next second, her phone lit up.

The program crew sent the received text message to her mobile phone.

Song Er'er looked down.

There was only one sentence on the screen.

【you're right.】

No signature.

But she guessed who it was almost immediately.

Song Er'er raised his head and looked at Lu Zhi opposite.

Lu Zhi also happened to look at her.

He looked calm, as if nothing happened.

Song Er'er stared at him for two seconds.

Then she turned to the host and asked: "Is it too late to return it now?"

Host: "?"

Song Er'er said seriously: "I'm afraid Mr. Lu's fans will assassinate me tonight."

Lu Zhi put down his phone and said calmly: "Don't be afraid."

Song Er'er: "What, you protect me?"

Lu Zhi glanced at her: "They can't scold you."

Song Er'er: "..."

Finally someone in the living room couldn't hold back his laughter.

The barrage completely exploded.

[Hahahahahaha, Lu Zhi, you have changed!】

[They can’t scold you, what kind of trust is this?】

[I was originally a fan of Lu Zhi, but now I want to hear Song Er'er curse.】

[This show is no longer called Heartbeat and Undefended. Let’s call it Song Er’er Undefended instead.】

[It’s over, I feel like I want to chase you.】

In the director's studio, Director Liu looked at the rising data and fell into silence for a long time.

The assistant director asked: "Director, will you still follow the original script tomorrow?"

Director Liu looked at Song Er'er who was arguing with Lu Zhi on the monitor and slowly shook his head.

"Original script?"

He laughed.

"The original script died from the moment she walked in the door."

At the same time, Song Er'er's phone vibrated again.

This time it’s not the show team’s cell phone.

It's her own cell phone.

Sister Qian sent a new message.

[Song Er'er, you'd better restrain yourself tonight.】

After Song Er'er finished reading, he lowered his head and replied.

【As much as possible.】

After thinking for a while, she added another sentence.

【But there is no guarantee.】

After sending it, she put the phone back into her pocket and looked up at the camera.

The camera was pointed right at her.

Song Er smiled.
